result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: layout, spacing, typography, and card components are consistent. No critical visual breakage detected; only minor polish suggestions.

issues.description: The category chip row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) has a partially visible chip at the right edge with no visual affordance indicating horizontal scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade-out gradient or partial peek of the next chip to signal scrollability.
